abstract: Favoritism as a mode of corruption is a major concern in public procurement (PP) in many countries. We propose a regression discontinuity design (RDD) test arguing that the winning history of marginal winners and losers can be used to detect favoritism. We apply the empirical test to PP of cleaning services in Finland and find evidence of favoritism even in this relatively low corruption environment. First, winners of close races in terms of win margin tend to have won more also in the past, which is in contrast to competitive environment. Second, to rule out an alternative explanation of collusion based on incumbency, we show that these winners also tend to submit their bids the last, indicating information sharing about rival bids from the buyer to the favored bidder.
abstract_zh: 偏袒作为一种腐败形式，是许多国家公共采购（PP）中的主要问题。我们提出了一种断点回归设计（RDD）检验，认为边际获胜者与失败者的获胜历史可用于检测偏袒行为。我们将该实证检验应用于芬兰清洁服务公共采购中，发现即使在腐败程度相对较低的环境中，偏袒现象依然存在。首先，以微弱优势获胜的竞标者（即获胜幅度接近的竞标者）往往在过去也赢得更多合同，这与竞争性环境形成对比。其次，为排除基于在位优势的合谋替代解释，我们证明这些获胜者还倾向于最后提交标书，这表明买方与受偏袒的竞标者之间存在关于竞争对手报价的信息共享。
title: Detecting Favoritism in Public Procurement
title_zh: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为

abstract: The consensus view among economists is that carbon prices, in order to be efficient, must be the same across the globe. But when there are inefficiencies in the allocation of capital so that countries are subject to different discount rates, we show that efficient carbon prices must be different across countries. This is a consequence of Hotelling’s familiar argument on the price of a non-renewable resource: it must grow at the rate of the next best use of marginal funds, which is equal to the country’s discount rate. If different countries discount at different rates, their carbon prices ought to grow at different rates as well. If they grow at different rates, they can’t be the same all of the time, as first-best carbon prices are. The computational climate policy literature has so far avoided this conclusion by altering time preferences in a country-specific way through time-varying Negishi weights. We show that the use of such weights causes inefficient policy prescriptions and, furthermore, has the particularly undesirable consequence of incorrectly discounting future consumption more in countries with high growth rates. The existence of inefficiencies in the savings process—causing differences in discount rates—is well-known and should be acknowledged head on in climate policy analysis. Doing so results in global mitigation policy with carbon price paths for different countries growing (efficiently) at different rates.
abstract_zh: 经济学家普遍认为，碳价格若要实现效率最优，必须在全球范围内保持一致。然而，当资本配置存在效率损失，导致各国面临不同的贴现率时，我们证明有效的碳价格必须因国而异。这一结论源于霍特林关于不可再生资源价格的经典论证：碳价格必须以边际资金次优用途的增长率上升，而该增长率等于该国的贴现率。若不同国家的贴现率存在差异，其碳价格也应以不同速率增长。由于增长速率不同，碳价格便无法像最优状态那样始终保持一致。现有气候政策计算文献通过引入随时间变化的尼格希权重来调整各国的时间偏好，从而回避了这一结论。我们证明，使用此类权重会导致政策建议缺乏效率，并产生尤为不良的后果——在高增长国家中，未来消费被错误地以更高贴现率折现。储蓄过程中的效率损失（导致贴现率差异）是公认现象，气候政策分析应直面这一问题。如此制定的全球减排政策，将使不同国家的碳价格路径以（有效的）不同速率增长。

abstract: As a core component of human capital, education plays a pivotal role in shaping labour productivity. In remote and impoverished rural areas, limited access to post‐compulsory education creates a self‐perpetuating cycle of low education, low productivity, and entrenched poverty. Using data from China's Poverty Alleviation Through Relocation programme, this study examines the impact of relocation on children's post‐compulsory education, measured by high school enrolment. Employing a two‐way fixed effects model, we find that relocation increases the probability of high school enrolment by approximately 8.6 percentage points, with results robust to household controls and propensity score matching. Mechanism analysis provides suggestive evidence that these gains are associated with improved school accessibility, higher household income and increased educational investment. The effects are heterogeneous: educational gains are concentrated among male children and those in households with lower‐educated and older heads, are primarily driven by rural relocation, and increase with the duration since resettlement. The findings highlight both the potential and uneven distribution of human capital gains from relocation policies, providing important insights for targeted post‐relocation educational support in other developing country contexts.
abstract_zh: 作为人力资本的核心组成部分，教育在塑造劳动生产率方面发挥着关键作用。在偏远贫困的农村地区，义务教育后教育机会的匮乏形成了低教育水平、低生产率与根深蒂固贫困的自我循环。本研究利用中国易地扶贫搬迁项目数据，以高中入学率为衡量指标，考察搬迁对儿童义务教育后教育的影响。通过采用双向固定效应模型，我们发现搬迁使高中入学概率提升约8.6个百分点，该结果在加入家庭层面控制变量及倾向得分匹配后依然稳健。机制分析表明，这些教育收益与学校可达性改善、家庭收入提高及教育投资增加存在关联。异质性分析显示：教育收益集中于男性儿童、户主受教育程度较低及年龄较大的家庭；主要源于农村搬迁驱动；且随安置时间延长而递增。研究结果揭示了搬迁政策在人力资本积累方面的潜力与分配不均问题，为其他发展中国家制定针对性的搬迁后教育支持政策提供了重要启示。

abstract: In Naylor, Deaton, and Ker (2025), we discuss an appropriate econometric method for estimating the pass‐through of the Nutrition North subsidy in the presence of heterogeneous effects and endogenous sampling. Applying this method to the data set compiled by Galloway and Li (2023), who conclude that there is “large leakage” of the subsidy, we fail to find evidence that supports their conclusion. After our paper was published, Galloway and Li published both a corrigendum to their 2023 article and a comment to our paper based on that corrigendum. In their comment, Galloway and Li (2026) claim that after “minor but easily justified” changes to their original data, our econometric approach leads to either imprecise or incomplete estimates of pass‐through. In our response we show that: (i) Galloway and Li (2026) choose a classification of market structure that differs from the one recommended by federal government officials and from the classification they themselves use in their most recent work, including Galloway and Li (2025b) and Li, Daley, and Watson (2025); (ii) the classification structure consistent with the recommendations of federal government officials and their aforementioned research supports full pass‐through; (iii) Galloway and Li's (2026) removal of 75% of the original sample is not minor; and (iv) Galloway and Li's (2026) repeated emphasis on sub‐sampling, robustness, and statistical power is incomplete and thus misleading. Importantly, our response emphasizes that the correct econometric approach does not turn on whether one can selectively find a data set in which the empirical estimate of pass‐through changes.
abstract_zh: 在Naylor、Deaton与Ker（2025）的研究中，我们探讨了在存在异质性效应与内生抽样条件下，估算“营养北方”补贴传导效应的适当计量方法。将该方法应用于Galloway与Li（2023）编制的数据集（该研究得出补贴存在“大量渗漏”的结论）后，我们未能发现支持其结论的证据。论文发表后，Galloway与Li针对其2023年文章发布了勘误，并基于该勘误对我们的论文发表了评论。在评论中，Galloway与Li（2026）声称，对其原始数据进行“微小但易于论证”的调整后，我们的计量方法对传导效应的估算要么不精确，要么不完整。我们的回应表明：（i）Galloway与Li（2026）选择的市场结构分类，既不同于联邦政府官员推荐的分类标准，也不同于其自身最新研究（包括Galloway与Li（2025b）及Li、Daley与Watson（2025））所使用的分类；（ii）与联邦政府官员建议及上述研究一致的分类结构支持完全传导效应；（iii）Galloway与Li（2026）剔除75%原始样本的做法并非“微小调整”；（iv）Galloway与Li（2026）反复强调子样本分析、稳健性与统计功效的做法不完整且具有误导性。重要的是，我们的回应强调：正确的计量方法并不取决于能否选择性找到传导效应实证估计值发生变化的数据集。
title: Reply to Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”

abstract: Despite major institutional reforms, the European Banking Union remains incomplete. Banking markets remain fragmented along national lines, which constrains Europe’s growth potential. This column uses loan-level data from the European credit registry combined with the bank group structure dataset to quantify where the barriers to cross-border lending lie, what role cross-country regulatory differences play, and how much output Europe forgoes as a result. It finds that the binding constraints sit on the extensive margin, that is, forming relationships and entering markets, that they are closely related to regulatory fragmentation, and that lifting them may deliver sizeable economic gains.
abstract_zh: 尽管经历了重大制度改革，欧洲银行业联盟仍不完善。银行业市场仍沿国界分割，这制约了欧洲的增长潜力。本专栏利用欧洲信贷登记机构的贷款级数据，结合银行集团结构数据集，量化了跨境贷款的障碍所在、跨国监管差异的作用，以及由此导致的欧洲产出损失。研究发现，约束性障碍主要存在于广延边际层面，即建立关系和进入市场方面，这些障碍与监管碎片化密切相关，而消除这些障碍可能带来可观的经济收益。

abstract: Populist leaders increasingly cast public sector experts, oversight bodies, and career civil servants as illegitimate ‘elites’ standing in the way of the popular will. But bureaucratic institutions may protect the economy from the very disruptions that populists invite. This column examines the role of bureaucracy in mediating the negative effects of populist governments at the US state level. The results suggest that bureaucracy matters. In countries and states with career civil‐service protections, the usual drag of populist governance largely vanishes, but without those institutional cushions, the economy takes a hit. What matters is whether the bureaucracy is professional and insulated from political control.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人日益将公共部门专家、监督机构及职业公务员视为阻碍民意的非法“精英阶层”。然而，官僚机构或许能保护经济免受民粹主义所引发的动荡。本专栏考察了美国州级层面官僚机构在调节民粹主义政府负面影响中的作用。研究结果表明，官僚机构至关重要。在拥有职业公务员保护制度的国家与州，民粹主义治理通常带来的经济拖累基本消失；但若缺乏这些制度缓冲，经济将遭受冲击。关键在于官僚体系是否具备专业性且不受政治控制。
authors: Massimo Morelli, Dmitrii Petrukhin, Matia Vannoni
title: Don’t drain the swamp! Populism, bureaucracy, and economic performance

abstract: Public employment guarantee schemes, which channeled graduates into lifetime positions in the civil service and state-owned enterprises, were central to state-led industrialization across the postcolonial world, yet they have remained far less studied than temporary workfare programs. This paper provides the first causal estimates of their labor market effects, exploiting the Arab Republic of Egypt's archetypal public employment guarantee, which from the early 1960s guaranteed public sector jobs to secondary and university graduates without competitive examination. The paper measures district-level exposure by secondary school supply on the eve of the reform (1959/60) and links it to individual-level census microdata from 1986, 1996, and 2006. Using an event-study design with continuous treatment intensity, the analysis compares cohorts that differed in age at the time of the public employment guarantee's introduction across districts with differing pre-reform school supply. The findings show that the public employment guarantee reallocated urban male wage employment away from the private sector and toward state-owned enterprises, with no comparable shift in rural districts, where state-owned enterprises were largely absent. The reallocation was concentrated in manufacturing and high-skilled white-collar occupations, consistent with the policy channeling educated workers into sectors that were central to the state's industrialization drive. The paper finds little evidence that the public employment guarantee raised educational attainment, indicating that it primarily redirected an already growing pool of educated workers rather than expanding the supply of schooling.
abstract_zh: 公共就业保障计划是后殖民世界国家主导工业化的核心举措，它将毕业生引入公务员和国有企业的终身职位，但相较于临时工作福利计划，其研究程度远为不足。本文首次对其劳动力市场效应进行因果估计，利用阿拉伯埃及共和国的典型公共就业保障制度——自20世纪60年代初起，该制度保证中学和大学毕业生无需竞争性考试即可获得公共部门职位。本文以改革前夕（1959/60年）的中学供给衡量地区级暴露程度，并将其与1986年、1996年和2006年的人口普查个体微观数据相关联。采用连续处理强度的事件研究设计，分析比较了在公共就业保障制度引入时年龄不同的队列，这些队列分布在改革前学校供给存在差异的地区。研究结果表明，公共就业保障将城市男性工资就业从私营部门重新配置到国有企业，而在国有企业基本缺失的农村地区则未出现类似转变。这种重新配置集中于制造业和高技能白领职业，与政策将受教育工人引导至国家工业化核心部门的逻辑一致。本文未发现公共就业保障显著提高教育程度的证据，表明其主要重新引导了本已增长的受教育工人群体，而非扩大教育供给。
